# Generating Divergent Concepts

## Core principle

Produce mechanism-distinct concepts while delaying cross-agent anchoring and selection. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a confirmed implementation plan
- a task where only one legally valid solution exists
